Reasoning: This stage keeps the already grasped top_drawer_handle_frame held while pulling it open. The object_grasped term represents maintaining the physical closed grasp on the handle; close_gripper is not also emitted because object_grasped is the appropriate held-object constraint. The directional_move term commands the grasped handle/drawer motion 0.14 m along top_drawer_handle_frame local -y, with 0.01 m tolerance, representing the requested open displacement; its condition includes geometry for reaching the displacement and manipulator_high_effort to encode the supported early-stop alternative for excessive resistance or jamming. The freeze_orientation term keeps panda_fingertip orientation fixed within 5 degrees during the pull. Direct bilateral finger effort/contact sensing, slip detection from gripper effort, explicit gripper joint position monitoring, and direct top_drawer_center_frame displacement control cannot be represented by the available operators; the center-frame open state is approximated through the rigidly grasped handle moving along the drawer opening direction.
